case.task_context:
## 1. Create pi-explore-continue.yml

- [x] 1.1 Create new workflow file `.github/workflows/pi-explore-continue.yml`
- [x] 1.2 Define trigger: `issue_comment: [created]`
- [x] 1.3 Add concurrency group: `pi-explore-${{ github.event.issue.number }}`
- [x] 1.4 Add permissions: `issues: write`, `contents: write`, `pull-requests: write`
- [x] 1.5 Add bot comment detection step (skip if `<!-- PI-BOT-COMMENT -->`)
- [x] 1.6 Add bot sender detection step (skip if `sender.type == "Bot"`)

## 2. Setup Steps (Continue Workflow)

- [x] 2.1 Add Setup Node.js step (version 20.19.0)
- [x] 2.2 Add Install PI agent step (`npm install -g @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent`)
- [x] 2.3 Add Install OpenSpec CLI step (`npm install -g @fission-ai/openspec@latest`)
- [x] 2.4 Add Configure PI Agent step (auth.json + settings.json from vars/secrets)
- [x] 2.5 Add Restore session cache step (key: `pi-session-{issue-number}`)

## 3. Agent Execution (Continue Workflow)

- [x] 3.1 Add Checkout repository step (provides clean baseline)
- [x] 3.2 Add Fetch latest comment step (get only the new comment from API)
- [x] 3.3 Add Run PI agent step (use explore skill with session + new comment)
- [x] 3.4 Add Post response to issue step (with `<!-- PI-BOT-COMMENT -->` marker)

## 4. Git-Based Change Detection

- [x] 4.1 Add git status check step for `openspec/changes/` directory
- [x] 4.2 Parse output to determine if changes were detected
- [x] 4.3 Output `changes_detected` boolean for conditional steps

## 5. PR Creation (When Changes Detected)

- [x] 5.1 Add Create branch step (branch name: `openspec/issue-{issue-number}`)
- [x] 5.2 Add Configure git user step (name: `pi-bot[bot]`, email: `[EMAIL_REDACTED]`)
- [x] 5.3 Add Stage and commit step (commit message: "Create change proposal")
- [x] 5.4 Add Push branch step
- [x] 5.5 Add Create PR step (title: "Change proposal: {issue-title}", body: "Closes #{issue-number}")
- [x] 5.6 Add Apply openspec-auto-ff label step

## 6. Session Persistence

- [x] 6.1 Add Save session cache step (always run, use `if: always()`)
- [x] 6.2 Ensure session is saved after both normal run and PR creation

## 7. Update pi-explore.yml (Bootstrap Workflow)

- [x] 7.1 Remove `issue_comment` trigger from `pi-explore.yml`
- [x] 7.2 Keep only `issues: [opened]` trigger
- [x] 7.3 Remove all comment-related conditional steps
- [x] 7.4 Verify bootstrap workflow still works correctly

## 8. Update pi-auto-ff.yml (Handle Partial Artifacts)

- [x] 8.1 Update verification logic to not require `proposal.md` for initial commit
- [x] 8.2 Ensure auto-ff can complete partial artifacts after PR creation
- [x] 8.3 Add graceful handling when proposal.md is missing during auto-ff

## 9. Testing

- [ ] 9.1 Test bootstrap workflow with a new issue
- [ ] 9.2 Test continue workflow with a follow-up comment
- [ ] 9.3 Test that explore skill can create artifacts in `openspec/changes/`
- [ ] 9.4 Test that PR is created automatically when changes are detected
- [ ] 9.5 Test that session persistence works across runs
- [ ] 9.6 Test concurrency control (multiple rapid comments)
- [ ] 9.7 Test error handling (LLM failure, network issues)
